# Preface {-}

Welcome to the PS2010 Psychological Research Methods and Analysis workshop code book.

This site will collect the workshop code and examples for the new teaching year. Chapters will be added as the module progresses.

For material from the previous year, see the [2025 code book](https://luke-kendrick.github.io/ps2010_codebook_25/).
